name: Intake
description: When a request arrives, what your outlines already hold on it, and any likely duplicate, written under it.

outlines.description: other outlines to search, each { outline, machine? } (machine: an ssh config name; left out, this machine)

archive.description: a command that searches an archive: %word% is the request's most telling word (letters, digits and -), every word is on its stdin, and each line it prints is a hit; exit 1 with nothing printed is no hits (for example ["ssh", "float-box", "rg", "-l", "-i", "-m1", "%word%", "/srv/archive/notes"]). Left out, no archive

answer.description: a command that reads what was found on stdin and prints the note's words (for example ["claude", "-p"]). Left out, the list and a duplicate line from the titles alone

limit.description: the most hits shown from each place

actions.label: Look for prior art
actions.description: Under the request, a note "Prior art and related": run by a rule, it asks @prior-art; run by hand, it searches at once (no model)

agents.name: prior-art
agents.description: Searches this outline, the others in config and the archive for what came before a request, and fills in its "Prior art and related" note
